response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with genuine systems-programming depth (low-latency DLang services handling millions of requests per second, C/C++ IDE components) and strong mentoring instincts through workshops and open source. However, he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience — his C++ work amounts to roughly a year across one role and a thesis — and his career has centered on full-stack web/product development rather than cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure ownership. He also lacks formal technical-leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers on high-impact platform projects.
strengths: High-performance distributed systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, low-latency services)
Strong engineering-practice advocacy: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus teaching workshops and running dojos
Broad, adaptable technical range across backend, infrastructure tooling, Kubernetes, and open-source project ownership
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ — only a brief stint at National Instruments plus a thesis project
Career trajectory is full-stack web/product engineering (TypeScript/Node.js), not cloud compute platforms or storage/hardware architecture
No formal technical-leadership role leading strategy, priorities, and cross-team alignment at platform scale

key_factors.factor: Real distributed-systems and performance engineering background
